deviations: CPU execution instead of the paper's A100 GPU
the official Dataset casts each item to float32 on every access; this calibration materializes exactly the same float32 tensors once and machine-checks bitwise equality at fixed indices

the released transition prior materializes a full batch-by-batch Jacobian and extracts its diagonal; this run computes the identical diagonal as grad(output.sum(), input) and checks forward values, parameter gradients, one Adam update, no-grad validation, and the paper batch size 64 against the released path
num_workers is zero to avoid interprocess copies of an already memory-resident dataset

diagonal_jacobian_equivalence.method: compare the released autograd.functional.jacobian diagonal with autograd.grad(output.sum(), inputs), including all parameter gradients and one Adam update on a seeded batch

purpose: exact paper-scale 100-epoch learned TRACE retraining and unseen-intermediate-state evaluation on CPU
